method: Read-only native Evaluate using LET to evaluate each expression once. Result classes: zero=0, positive=1, negative=2, TRUE=3, FALSE=4; errors are minus ERROR.TYPE. Equality controls distinguish truncation from rounding. REPT keeps each Evaluate expression below its 255-character API limit.
criteriaMethod: COUNTIF over formula-produced text in the existing disposable worksheet. ISTEXT was true for every source cell.
